finding: Confirmed ill-typed universal [F] dot n notation. Momentum flux is a 3x3 matrix and requires its matrix-vector normal product. The explicit displayed momentum jump was already correctly typed.

edits.before_excerpt: Equivalently, for any conservative density $U$ and flux $F$ above, the interface coefficient is $[F]\cdot n-V_n[U]$; it must vanish for conservation and be nonnegative for physical entropy.
edits.after_excerpt: Equivalently, for any conservative density $U$ and flux $F$ above, the interface coefficient is $[F]n-V_n[U]$. Here $[F]n$ is matrix-vector multiplication for the momentum flux; for each scalar law its vector flux is identified with a one-row matrix, so $[F]n=[F]\cdot n$. The coefficient must vanish for conservation and be nonnegative for physical entropy.

edits.after_excerpt: integration on the two sides gives interface coefficient $[F]n-V_n[U]$, using the scalar-law row identification stated above;
